disclosures.title: Zain Group Annual Report 2025 - Zain KSA section
disclosures.body_text: Official parent annual report section covering Zain KSA ownership, strategy and operating performance.

disclosures.title: Zain KSA FY2025 operating update
disclosures.body_text: Zain KSA reported 8.1 million customers, blended ARPU of USD 17 and USD 357 million of capex in 2025.

disclosures.title: 5G and digital growth engines
disclosures.body_text: Zain KSA identified 5G, enterprise services, Yaqoot and Tamam as key contributors to growth and diversification.

disclosures.title: FY2025 dividend recommendation
disclosures.body_text: The board recommended a cash dividend of SAR 0.50 per share for 2025.

disclosures.title: Zain KSA ownership and free float
disclosures.body_text: At 31 December 2025 Zain Group held 37%, a Saudi consortium held 21%, and 42% was free float on the Saudi Exchange.

disclosures.title: FY2025 5G and digital infrastructure update
disclosures.body_text: The 5G network covered 66 cities; approximately 1,000 sites were added, extending population coverage to another 700,000 people and enabling 5G Standalone readiness for VoNR, VoWiFi, handover, roaming and gaming use cases.

disclosures.title: FY2025 market capitalization and share price
disclosures.body_text: Zain KSA market capitalization was approximately USD 2.45 billion at 31 December 2025, based on a SAR 10.26 share price.

disclosures.title: Suboptimal customer experience and BSS transformation
disclosures.body_text: Material risks include elevated network complaints, digital-experience gaps, BSS delivery delays, change-request volume and launch outages. Mitigation includes journey redesign, process digitization, transformation KPIs, automated campaign targeting and reassessment of the long-term BSS strategy.

disclosures.title: B2C and B2B competitive pressure
disclosures.body_text: Consumer profitability faces international-cost, commission, competition and fiberization pressure; B2B faces pricing pressure, limited fiber infrastructure, tender participation and collection risks. Mitigation includes new propositions, partner and pricing changes, fiber expansion and strengthened collections.

disclosures.title: Network investment monetization
disclosures.body_text: Competition and pricing pressure may constrain returns and funding for access, fiber and 5G SA investment. Zain KSA prioritizes regulatory and network needs, reviews business cases, shares infrastructure and plans to monetize 5G SA use cases using digital and data analytics.

disclosures.title: Regulatory, privacy and data-governance risk
disclosures.body_text: Evolving CST frameworks and PDPL/NDMO obligations create compliance and execution risk. Mitigation includes regulatory engagement, a data-protection and governance framework, mandatory policies, trained data stewards and weekly steering oversight.

disclosures.title: Information-security and cyber risk
disclosures.body_text: Digitalization, cloud adoption and geopolitical events increase DDoS and critical-infrastructure threats. Controls include assessments, penetration tests, phishing simulations, employee training, cloud DDoS mitigation and Cyber Defense Center enhancements.

disclosures.title: Talent-management risk
disclosures.body_text: Competition for digital skills creates attrition and capability risks. Mitigation includes skill-gap assessments, reskilling, university partnerships, graduate programs, career paths, learning academies, engagement and performance incentives.
